name: Yaoyao
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on the healer build: 4pc Deepwood Memories first (KQM: best if no one else in a Dendro team holds it) with 4pc Tenacity of the Millelith as the other, an ER or HP% Sands, an HP% Goblet, an HP%, Healing Bonus or (with Favonius) CRIT Rate Circlet, and Skill > Burst > Normal Attack. KQM adds Instructor, Maiden Beloved, Gilded Dreams (her personal damage) and The Exile; both also give an EM-based reaction build (EM on every piece) that is not the main plan. Weapons differ in the lead: KQM puts Dialogues of the Desert Sages first, Game8 puts Favonius Lance first for healers (Kitain Cross Spear for its Bloom build); all are kept. Her healing is Max HP-based, so the scaling stat is HP. The kit's 'check' line (White Jade Radish DMG, 29.9% to 53.9%) is ATK-based Dendro damage on the elemental curve (ratio 1.80), the damage that matters, so the damage talent is the Skill. ER is Game8's 200 for the healer builds (KQM: 190-210 Double Dendro from C2, 260-270 Solo Dendro under C2, 170-180 Triple Dendro from C2). No HP goal is given. Partners are inferred from the Dendro and Bloom teams both sources name.
